title: routine.record.v1: a routine record a person wrote
description: The authority a plugin holding 'schedule' asks a run from (host.v1.json x-run-request, record kind 'routine.v1'): WHAT may be started (tenant, engine, prompt) and which plugin may ask for it. WHEN it runs is the plugin's and is not kept here. The core owns the store; only the person writes, changes or removes a record, through the core's own commands, as the owner on the owner-only socket or a paired device (written_by). A plugin's write is refused 'writer_not_allowed' and nothing is stored. record_id, plugin, tenant, engine and prompt are the person's; kind, revision, written_by and written_at are the core's. Every field not listed here is refused.

record_id.description: The id a run.request names (host.v1.json x-run-request record_id).

plugin.description: The one plugin that may ask for a run from this record.

writer.description: Who wrote the record last: a principal that stands for the person. The server derives it from the way the request came in; it is never read from the request.
